picks.what: View across the Garonne, engraving in Zeiller and Merian’s Topographia Galliae (Amsterdam Museum)

picks.file: Vue de la ville et du pont de Pierre - 1830.JPG

picks.what: The city across the Garonne from La Bastide, photochrom print (Library of Congress)

gaps: P0: no candidates (#1 is misdated, really 1572). P6: only a bland rooftop view (#32) and high-altitude airplane shots; skipped
notes: Merian date: Amsterdam Museum gives only 1650–99; the Bordeaux plate belongs to the Topographia Galliae (1655–61), so labeled about 1657. #26 postcard was mailed in March 1937 and shows the transporter bridge towers (stood 1913–42); file title says about 1930. Hugo d’Alesi bird’s-eye (#30, #31) skipped: undated and photographed at an angle with glare.
